title: DM member list change rules (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A (SEP2-5/CRY2-5, plus CON2-3): the DM admission host accepts DMMembers changes only as: add (by a current member, sent with the MLS Add they commit, subject to DM consent rules), remove self; never removal of other members; the compliance logger can never be removed; each update carries a strictly increasing sequence number and timestamp (no replay). Committers of an Add MUST send the DMMembers update.
